prompt:
Design the front of a 5 x 7 portrait holiday card.

Illustration: a cosy winter scene in a warm gouache style, a small red cottage in deep snow at dusk, warm light in every window, a string of lights across the porch, pine trees behind, big soft snowflakes falling. Limited palette of cream, deep green, warm red and gold.

Greeting, exactly, in hand-lettered brush script in cream across the sky area: "Warm wishes from our home to yours". Nothing else written anywhere on the card.

Leave a quarter-inch clean margin for print bleed. No border line, no year, no names.
